landing.heroTitle: From Community Needs to Measurable, Verifiable Impact
landing.heroSubtitle: A digital platform connecting accredited associations, volunteers, and community initiatives across Algeria — helping transform local needs into organized action and measurable outcomes.
landing.archNotice: Strict Traceability Protocol • Zero Unverified Claims
landing.challengeTitle: The Challenge: Fragmented initiatives and lack of verifiable outcomes
landing.challengeSubtitle: Algerian civil society possesses immense dedication and volunteer energy, but faces persistent structural hurdles.
landing.challenge1Desc: Actions frequently rely on informal, decentralized channels, making sustained volunteer mobilization and skill-matching difficult.
landing.challenge2Desc: Associations lack standardized tools to certify field presence and volunteer hours for institutional partners and academic credits.
landing.challenge3Desc: Reports often depend on self-reported estimates without independent verification, undermining broad institutional trust.
landing.approachTitle: The NEXUS DZ Approach: Structuring Civic Action
landing.approachSubtitle: A methodical bridge connecting community goodwill to certified, public-interest outcomes.
landing.pillar1Desc: Verifying legal association charters and wilaya accreditations under Algerian law (Law 12-06 on associations).
landing.pillar2Desc: Breaking initiatives into actionable, timestamped tasks with clear skill requirements and deliverables.
landing.pillar3Desc: Verified attendance rosters, activity logbooks, and timestamped photo evidence with indicative geolocation.
landing.pillar4Desc: Organizing teams do not certify their own outcomes; accredited third-party verifiers examine submitted evidence.
landing.forOrgsSubtitle: Dedicated tools to elevate operational rigor and showcase certified credibility to partners.
landing.orgStep1: 1. Submit association dossier and registration details
landing.orgStep2: 2. Publish structured initiatives with clear targets
landing.orgStep3: 3. Mobilize volunteer teams and manage attendance rosters
landing.orgStep4: 4. Upload completion reports and evidence for audit
landing.forVolsSubtitle: Serve your community with structure and build an accredited, certified volunteer portfolio.
landing.volStep1: 1. Explore local initiatives by commune and sector
landing.volStep2: 2. Apply directly to tasks matched to your skills
landing.volStep3: 3. Carry out field work and verify your actual presence
landing.volStep4: 4. Earn officially certified civic service hours
landing.capabilitiesSubtitle: Software infrastructure tailored to grassroots civil society and governance requirements.
landing.cap1Desc: Timeline scheduling, resource budgeting, and field team coordination.
landing.cap2Desc: Minute-accurate volunteer presence tracking to eliminate arbitrary estimations.
landing.cap3Desc: Secure storage of field reports, photographs, and signed beneficiary receipt logs.
landing.cap4Desc: Clear differentiation between planned targets and formally verified outcomes.
landing.principlesSubtitle: The ethical standard governing every component of NEXUS DZ.
landing.principle1Desc: No beneficiary count or volunteer hour is published without supporting documented proof.
landing.principle2Desc: Initial project goals are strictly segregated from audited, verified outcomes.
landing.principle3Desc: Project creators cannot validate their own impact metrics; independent reviewers oversee audits.
landing.principle4Desc: Strict rejection of synthetic statistics, simulated metrics, or fictional partnerships.
landing.ctaTitle: Join the Movement to Structure Civic Action in Algeria
landing.ctaSubtitle: We welcome accredited associations and active volunteers in Constantine Province to participate in the pilot phase.

about.title: About NEXUS DZ
about.subtitle: A civic-tech initiative dedicated to integrity, volunteer empowerment, and measurable community impact in Algeria.
about.missionBody: NEXUS DZ was conceived to equip Algerian civil society with trustworthy digital infrastructure. By pairing structured volunteer mobilization with independent field evidence auditing, the platform allows associations to demonstrate the authentic reach of their public-benefit programs.
about.scopeBody: Initial rollout is concentrated across the communes of Constantine Province (Constantine Center, El Khroub, Ali Mendjeli, Ain Smara, Hamma Bouziane, Didouche Mourad, Zighoud Youcef) to rigorously refine audit mechanisms before progressive national expansion.
about.gov1: Strict adherence to the legal framework governing associations in Algeria (Law 12-06 on associations).
about.gov2: Three-way verification protocol: project charter, on-site attendance log, and signed completion records.
about.gov3: Impartiality: strict separation between initiative organizers and impact verifiers.
about.gov4: Full protection of personal data belonging to volunteers and beneficiaries, with zero commercial monetization.
